definition: goods carried by a large vehicle
description: A woman in a light blue uniform shirt and a peaked cap with a winged badge stands in a container terminal, checking papers on a clipboard that already carry round red marks. She lifts a heavy red stamp over her head and brings it down hard, first on the paperwork and then on the lids of big wooden shipping crates lined up on a rack, watched by dockworkers in hi-vis vests. The shot then runs down a long aisle between walls of stacked shipping containers, with gantry cranes lowering their spreaders overhead and a forklift parked among more crates, and ends with her standing alone in the middle of the aisle.
